name: gradient-fabled-sunset
title: Fabled Sunset
description: A static gradient moving from a very dark indigo-violet on the left through deep royal purple and finishing in a strong hot pink on the right, carried in a wide rounded panel.
use: A dark, moody sweep with a pink accent suits a night-mode landing or event page.
avoid: Both ends are quite dark and hardcoded, so overlaid text needs its own contrast work.
a11y: Pure decoration with nothing interactive, so no accessibility affordances are needed. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage. The left end is a very dark blue-violet, the centre is a deep royal purple, and the right end brightens into a saturated hot pink, blended on a shallow diagonal.
behaves: Static: nothing animates or reacts; the same dark-to-pink sweep appears in each frame.
customise: className and style set the size or replace the paint; the indigo, purple and pink stops are hardcoded in the file.
weight: light: One div with one CSS gradient and no runtime work.
issues: Packet claims a full-bleed footprint while the frames show a rounded card with margins.
polishWhy: Smooth, rich blend and clean corners; still a simple static swatch.
